name: Ganzhou

queries.query: Ganzhou official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS natural resources bureau 赣州 地籍图 不动产登记
queries.scope: Find city-specific official land registry evidence and inspect anonymous map, service schema and parcel geometry routes.
queries.result: The official city-map article links a RAR5 archive that an ordinary anonymous HTTPS GET fetched successfully (HTTP 200; 20,223,190 bytes). Its non-extracting archive manifest contains exactly three static JPEG map images (traffic, administrative, and general maps; all dated 2021-11-19), with no GIS/vector files or parcel-feature schema. The city registration guide limits record queries to eligible parties and application channels; no record query was made. No anonymous parcel geometry was returned or retained.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English web search followed by direct review of official local pages and anonymous public map/service entry points.
